inputs.text: [serious] At the same time, in India, GIANT volcanoes were spewing out lava for thousands of years. [pauses] A huge cloud of smoke rises, and rises, [amazed] and covers the whole sky. It turns dark, dark, dark. [softly] The sun? Hidden.
[gasps] The sun disappeared? How do the plants manage?

[softly] Good question! [pauses] Without sun, plants stop growing. They get too cold, too hungry for light. [serious] And here's the problem: without plants, the big plant-eaters — Brachiosaurus, Triceratops — have nothing to eat. [amazed] That's why everything changes.
